# csv_content is available - re-parse with \r stripping
csv_rows = csv_content.replace('\r', '').strip().split('\n')
header_row = csv_rows[0]
data_rows = csv_rows[1:]

won_deals_final = []
for row in data_rows:
    cols = row.split(",")
    status_val = cols[6].strip()
    if status_val == "won":
        won_deals_final.append({
            "deal_id": cols[0],
            "rep": cols[1],
            "region": cols[2],
            "product": cols[3],
            "amount": float(cols[4]),
            "close_date": cols[5]
        })

total_won_final = sum(d["amount"] for d in won_deals_final)

# Region breakdown
by_region = {}
for d in won_deals_final:
    by_region[d["region"]] = by_region.get(d["region"], 0) + d["amount"]

print(f"Columns: {header_row}")
print(f"Total deals: {len(data_rows)} | Won deals: {len(won_deals_final)}")
print(f"\nWon deal details:")
for d in won_deals_final:
    print(f"  {d['deal_id']:5s} | {d['rep']:16s} | {d['region']:6s} | {d['product']:24s} | ${d['amount']:>10,.2f} | {d['close_date']}")
print(f"\n{'='*90}")
print(f"TOTAL WON CONTRACT VALUE: ${total_won_final:,.2f}")
print(f"\nBy region:")
for r, t in sorted(by_region.items(), key=lambda x: -x[1]):
    print(f"  {r}: ${t:,.2f}")
print(f"\nQ3 report currently states: $1,040,000")
print(f"Actual from CSV data:      ${total_won_final:,.2f}")
print(f"Discrepancy:               ${total_won_final - 1_040_000:,.2f}")
